info.name: Apollo B7A6 Housing & Roommate Platform API
info.description:
Versioned backend API for the Housing & Roommate Platform (Node.js + TypeScript + Express + Prisma + Stripe).

Generated from docs/openapi.json by scripts/gen-postman.js (OpenAPI 3.0.3).

HOW TO USE
1. Open the "Demo walkthrough (run in order)" folder and run requests 0-11 top to bottom.
2. The login requests capture adminToken, ownerToken, tenantToken and refreshToken into the
   collection variables, so every protected request runs without copying tokens by hand.
3. Create/booking/room requests capture propertyId, roomId, bookingId, paymentId and
   imageId automatically, so path parameters never need manual editing.
4. Requests 9 and 10 hit the same endpoint as different roles (403 vs 200) to demonstrate RBAC.
5. Request 8 returns a hosted Stripe checkout URL. Pay with test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.

Demo accounts
  admin   admin@housing.local / Admin1234!
  owner   owner@housing.local / Owner1234!
  tenant  tenant@housing.local / Tenant1234!

Set the "baseUrl" collection variable if you need to point this at another environment.

item.name: Demo walkthrough (run in order)
item.description: A self-contained demo that exercises the whole platform. Run 0-11 in order; each request prepares the variables the next one needs.

item.name: 0. Log in as all three roles

request.description: Confirms the deployment is up. Then run the three login requests that follow.
Stores adminToken and refreshToken in the collection variables, so the rest of the collection runs without copying tokens.
Stores ownerToken and refreshToken in the collection variables, so the rest of the collection runs without copying tokens.
Stores tenantToken and refreshToken in the collection variables, so the rest of the collection runs without copying tokens.
Seeded property with images, rooms and amenities.
Required before step 6. Creating a booking flips the room to RESERVED, so without this reset the second run of the walkthrough fails with 400 'Room is not available for booking'.
Stores bookingId for the steps that follow.
Runs in a single transaction: booking becomes APPROVED, the room becomes OCCUPIED and a Stripe PaymentIntent is created.
Returns a hosted checkoutUrl. Open it in the browser and pay with card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (no expiry or CVC needed). The webhook then flips the payment to SUCCEEDED.
Same endpoint returns 200 with the admin token and 403 here. That contrast is the RBAC proof.
Platform statistics: users, listings, occupancy, booking funnel, revenue, engagement, top properties.
